facts: The paper presents an unlexicalized parser for German.
The unlexicalized parser employs suffix analysis.
The unlexicalized parser achieves a labelled bracket F-score of 76.2.
The labelled bracket F-score of 76.2 is higher than previously reported results on the NEGRA corpus.
The use of smoothing in an unlexicalized parser allows better examination of the interplay between smoothing and parsing results.
There is an interplay between smoothing and parsing results.
Smoothing and suffix analysis are employed to achieve a labelled bracket F-score of 76.2.
Previously reported results were on the NEGRA corpus.
Smoothing is used in an unlexicalized parser.
The F-score mentioned is a labelled bracket F-score.
